                                                 DECREE

AMENDING ARTICLE 7 OF THE REGULATION ON FOREIGNERS AND VIETNAMESE RESIDING ABROAD WHO HIRE HOUSES IN VIETNAM

THE GOVERNMENT

Pursuant to the Law on Organization of the Government of September 30, 1992;

At the proposal of the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Construction,

                                                 DECREE

Article 1.- To amend Article 7 of the Regulation on the lease of houses in Vietnam to foreigners and Vietnamese residing abroad, promulgated together with Decree No. 56-CP of September 18, 1995, as follows:

The house rental shall be agreed upon by the two parties. The amounts to be remitted into the State budget by the house lessor must be based on the price stated in the house rental contract but must not be lower than the tax rate applicable in the locality, which is set by the President of the People's Committee of the province or city directly under the Central Government. In case the rental price in the locality fluctuates (±10%), the President of the People's Committee of the province or city directly under the Central Government shall readjust the tax calculation price in conformity with the actual price.

  Article 2.- This Decree takes effect on February 1st, 1997. The ministers, the heads of the ministerial-level agencies, the heads of the agencies attached to the Government and the presidents of the People’s Committees of the provinces and cities directly under the Central Government shall have to implement this Decree.


                                                            Phan Văn Khải

MEMORANDUM

BETWEEN THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OFFICE OF THE KINGDOM OF THAI LAN AND THE COPYRIGHT OFFICE OF VIETNAM ON COOPERATION IN THE DOMAIN OF COPYRIGHT AND CLOSE RELATIONS

The Intellectual Property Office of the Kingdom of Thailand and the Copyright Office of Vietnam, hereinafter referred to as the Parties.

- In the spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding between the Governments of the two countries;

- Being aware of the importance of copyright and close relations in the development of the literary and artistic fields as well as culture and economy in general;

- Desiring to promote close cooperation in the domain of copyright and close relations, laying the foundation for the economic and cultural development and prosperity between the two countries;

- Being aware of the necessity to expand mutual understanding among the countries in the region and the scope of cooperation in the protection of copyright and close relations through the enhancement of regional cooperation;

The two Parties have reached the following agreement:

  Article 1. Objectives and activities a/ To promote cooperation between the two countries' copyright and related rights management agencies; b/ To promote the development of human resources in the field of copyright and related rights, including training and exchange of experts in this field; c/ To step up the exchange of information on copyright and related rights; d/ To promote the settlement of common issues related to copyright and related rights as well as the protection of copyright and related rights between the two countries; e/ To promote cooperation and exchange between countries in the region; f/ To promote mutual protection of copyright and related rights for citizens of the two countries.

  Article 2: Scope of cooperation a/ Exchanging and disseminating information and documents related to copyright and relevant rights, including the electronic information network; b/ Developing human resources in the field of copyright and relevant rights, including training experts in copyright and relevant rights; c/ Through visits, the two sides shall study and exchange experiences; d/ Studying and comparing the copyright and relevant rights protection mechanisms of each country; e/ Enhancing cooperation between the two sides within the international scope of copyright and relevant rights; f/ Promoting cooperation between non-government organizations of the two countries in the field of copyright and relevant rights.

  Article 3. Exchange Officials of the concerned State agencies in charge of copyright and relevant rights of the two countries shall meet and exchange opinions in the course of cooperation between the two sides at least once a year. If necessary, the meeting may be held at the ministerial level.

  Article 4. Implementation provisions:

1. This Agreement shall not cause any damage to the rights and obligations of each Party to bilateral or multilateral agreements on copyright and related rights which each Party has signed or will sign.

  Article 5. Effect, amendment and termination of effect 1. This Memorandum takes effect when the Governments of the two Contracting Parties notify each other of the implementation of the provisions in the Memorandum.

2. The two Parties may terminate the effect of the Memorandum at any time by prior notice in writing for not more than 6 months through diplomatic channels.

3. The two Parties may amend this Memorandum through written exchanges. This Memorandum is signed in Hanoi on November 7, 1999, and made in two English copies of the same validity.
